question: Article 23 specifically prohibits which practice? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Child employment in hazardous industries
Compulsory service in the armed forces
Trafficking in human beings
Conferring of titles
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Trafficking in human beings

Explanation:
Article 23 of the Indian Constitution prohibits trafficking in human beings and forced labor (begar). It is a fundamental right under Part III and declares that traffic in human beings, begar, and other similar forms of forced labor are unconstitutional. However, the state may impose compulsory service for public purposes, provided no discrimination is made. Article 24 specifically prohibits employment of children in hazardous industries. Compulsory service in the armed forces or conferring of titles are not covered under Article 23. Thus, Article 23 primarily outlaws human trafficking and forced labor.

उपाधि प्रदान करना

Solution: सही उत्तर है मानव तस्करी

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान का अनुच्छेद 23 मानव तस्करी और बेगार (जबरन श्रम) को प्रतिबंधित करता है। यह मौलिक अधिकारों के अंतर्गत आता है और इसमें कहा गया है कि मानव तस्करी, बेगार और इसी प्रकार के अन्य जबरन श्रम असंवैधानिक हैं। हालांकि, राज्य सार्वजनिक उद्देश्यों के लिए अनिवार्य सेवा लगा सकता है, लेकिन इसके लिए भेदभाव नहीं किया जा सकता। अनुच्छेद 24 विशेष रूप से खतरनाक उद्योगों में बाल श्रम पर रोक लगाता है। सशस्त्र बलों में अनिवार्य सेवा या उपाधियों का प्रावधान अनुच्छेद 23 से संबंधित नहीं है। इस प्रकार, अनुच्छेद 23 मुख्य रूप से मानव तस्करी और जबरन श्रम पर रोक लगाता है।

question: Article 25 of the Indian Constitution primarily guarantees which of the following rights? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (17/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Right to equality before law
Cultural and educational rights
Freedom of religion
Right to constitutional remedies
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Freedom of religion

Explanation:
Article 25 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to freedom of religion. It grants every person the right to freely profess, practice, and propagate their religion, subject to public order, morality, health, and other fundamental rights. Articles 25 to 28 deal with the right to freedom of religion. Article 25 restricts state intervention in religious matters and allows all citizens to follow their own faith. This right is essential for maintaining the secular fabric of India. It is a fundamental right available to all persons, not just citizens. The state can regulate secular activities associated with religious practices for social welfare and reform.

question: The 86th Amendment added a new Fundamental Duty related to which of the following? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (16/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: Safeguarding public property
Protecting environment
Educating children
Defending the nation
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Educating children

Explanation:
The 86th Constitutional Amendment (2002) added a new Fundamental Duty under Article 51A, making it the duty of parents or guardians to provide opportunities for education to their children aged 6 to 14 years. This amendment was linked to making education a fundamental right under Article 21A. Originally, the Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976, which introduced 10 duties. Later, the 86th Amendment added an 11th duty related to children's education. This duty emphasizes the importance of education and helps in preventing child labor. It reflects the constitutional commitment to universal elementary education.

☛ Under which Article are Fundamental Duties listed? → Article 51A
☛ How many Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment? → 10
☛ How many Fundamental Duties are there in total now? → 11
question_hi: 86वें संशोधन में निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित एक नया मौलिक कर्तव्य शामिल किया गया? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (16/03/2026) Shift 1)
options_hi: सार्वजनिक संपत्ति की सुरक्षा
पर्यावरण के संरक्षण
बच्चों के शिक्षण
राष्ट्र की रक्षा
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है बच्चों के शिक्षण

Explanation:
86वें संविधान संशोधन (2002) ने मौलिक कर्तव्यों में एक नया कर्तव्य जोड़ा। अनुच्छेद 51A के तहत माता-पिता या अभिभावकों का कर्तव्य है कि वे अपने 6 से 14 वर्ष के बच्चों को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करें। यह संशोधन शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A) बनाने के साथ जुड़ा है। इससे पहले मौलिक कर्तव्यों की सूची में 11 कर्तव्य थे, जो 1976 में 42वें संशोधन द्वारा जोड़े गए थे। 86वें संशोधन ने 12वां मौलिक कर्तव्य जोड़ा, जो बच्चों की शिक्षा से संबंधित है। यह कर्तव्य समाज में शिक्षा के प्रति जागरूकता और बाल श्रम को रोकने में मदद करता है।

question: The 24th Constitutional Amendment gave the Parliament which of the following powers? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (22/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Override judicial review
Suspend the High Court judgment
Suspend elections
Amend Fundamental Rights
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Amend Fundamental Rights

Explanation:
The 24th Constitutional Amendment (1971) empowered Parliament to amend any part of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights. It amended Articles 13 and 368, clarifying that Parliament would follow the procedure under Article 368 for constitutional amendments, not the ordinary legislative process. This amendment was introduced to overturn the Supreme Court's judgment in the Golaknath case (1967), which held that Parliament cannot amend Fundamental Rights. However, in the Kesavananda Bharati case (1973), the Supreme Court propounded the basic structure doctrine, limiting Parliament's amending power and preventing damage to the Constitution's essential features.

☛ Kesavananda Bharati case → 1973 propounded the basic structure doctrine
☛ Year of 24th Amendment → 1971
☛ Which amendment gave power to amend Fundamental Rights → 24th Amendment
☛ Article 368 deals with → Constitutional amendment procedure

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs the State to take steps to organize Village Panchayats? (RRB ALP CBT 1 (11/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: Article 60
Article 40
Article 50
Article 30
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Article 40

Explanation:
Article 40 of the Indian Constitution comes under the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP). This Article directs the State to take steps to organize Village Panchayats as units of self-government. It is included in Part IV of the Constitution, which contains the Directive Principles. Although these are non-justiciable, they are fundamental in the governance of the country. Under Article 40, the State shall endeavor to endow panchayats with necessary powers and authority so that they can function as autonomous bodies. This forms the basis of the Panchayati Raj system, which gained constitutional status through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in 1992. The amendment added Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution, strengthening local self-governance.

☛ Part containing Article 40 → Part IV (DPSP)
☛ Amendment giving constitutional status to Panchayati Raj → 73rd Amendment 1992
☛ Three-tier system of Panchayati Raj → Gram Panchayat, Block Samiti, Zila Parishad
☛ Nature of Panchayats under Article 40 → Units of self-government
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद, राज्य को ग्राम पंचायतों को संगठित करने हेतु कदम उठाने का निर्देश देता है? (RRB ALP CBT 1 (11/03/2026) Shift 1)

question: The Government has proposed to include which Union Territory under the ambit of Article 240 of the Constitution? (RRB Technician Grade III (06/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: New Delhi
Chandigarh
Lakshadweep
Puduchery
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chandigarh

Explanation:
The Government of India has proposed to bring Chandigarh under the ambit of Article 240 of the Constitution. Article 240 empowers the President to make regulations for the administration of Union Territories. Currently, this article applies to Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, and Puducherry. Including Chandigarh will change its administrative setup, giving the President direct rule-making power. Presently, Chandigarh is administered by the Central Government. This move aims at administrative reform and policy clarity.

question: Which Fundamental Right explicitly prohibits human trafficking, forced labour, and the employment of children in hazardous occupations? (RRB Paramedical (12/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Right against Exploitation
Right to Freedom
Right to Equality
Right to Education
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Right against Exploitation

Explanation:
The Indian Constitution enshrines Fundamental Rights in Part III. The Right against Exploitation is covered under Articles 23 and 24. Article 23 prohibits human trafficking, forced labour, and similar forms of exploitation. Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 in hazardous occupations. This right protects citizens from economic and physical exploitation. The Right to Freedom (Articles 19-22) relates to speech, movement, etc. The Right to Equality (Articles 14-18) ensures equality before law. The Right to Education (Article 21A) provides free education to children aged 6-14. Thus, the correct option is the Right against Exploitation.

question: Which urban local body is meant for transitional or semi-urban areas? (RRB Paramedical (11/03/2026) Shift 1)

Notified Area Committee

solution:

Explanation:

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution obligates the State to secure equal pay for men and women doing comparable work? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (27/03/2026) Shift 2)

Article 39(d)
Article 38(1)
Article 42
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Article 39(d)

Explanation:
Article 39(d) of the Indian Constitution directs the State to ensure equal pay for equal work for both men and women. This Article falls under the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) in Part IV. Though not enforceable by courts, these principles are fundamental in governance. Article 39(d) promotes gender equality and social justice. In contrast, Article 42 deals with just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief, while Article 38(1) focuses on securing a social, economic, and political justice. Article 47(a) does not exist. Thus, the correct Article for equal pay is 39(d), which has been a strong pillar for gender equality since the Constitution's inception.

question: The Preamble primarily serves as which of the following? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (17/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: A financial guideline
A schedule to the Constitution
An enforceable part of law
A guiding principle for interpretation
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A guiding principle for interpretation

Explanation:
The Preamble to the Indian Constitution is a brief introductory statement that embodies the fundamental values and philosophy of the Constitution, such as justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity. It is not enforceable by law, meaning it cannot be directly taken to court if violated. However, it serves as a guiding principle for interpretation. The Supreme Court has used the Preamble in many landmark judgments to interpret ambiguous constitutional provisions and to understand the intent of the framers. For example, in the Berubari Union case (1960), the Court held that the Preamble is not a source of power but a key to understanding the Constitution. Thus, its primary function is to guide interpretation and not to act as an enforceable legal provision or a schedule.

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान की उद्देशिका (Preamble) एक संक्षिप्त परिचयात्मक कथन है जो संविधान के मूल उद्देश्यों और दर्शन को दर्शाती है। यह न्याय, स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुत्व जैसे मूल्यों पर आधारित है। उद्देशिका स्वयं कोई प्रवर्तनीय कानून नहीं है, अर्थात इसका उल्लंघन होने पर अदालत में सीधे मुकदमा नहीं किया जा सकता। हालांकि, यह संविधान के प्रावधानों की व्याख्या (interpretation) करने में एक मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत (guiding principle) का कार्य करती है। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने कई निर्णयों में उद्देशिका का उपयोग संवैधानिक प्रावधानों को समझने और अस्पष्टता को दूर करने के लिए किया है। इस प्रकार, उद्देशिका का मुख्य कार्य निर्वचन के लिए निर्देशक सिद्धांत के रूप में है।

question: The Preamble declares India to be which of the following? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (25/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Union
Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic
Sovereign, Federal, Secular, Democratic, Republic
Sovereign, Socialist, Federal, Democratic, Republic
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic

Explanation:
The Preamble of the Indian Constitution declares India to be a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic. 'Sovereign' means India is independent in internal and external affairs. 'Socialist' was added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976, emphasizing economic and social justice. 'Secular' means the state does not officially recognize any religion. 'Democratic' denotes a government elected by the people. 'Republic' means the head of the state is elected. The Preamble serves as an introduction to the Constitution and is considered its soul. It outlines the core values and objectives of the Indian polity, including justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity.

question: Providing free legal aid under Article 39A indirectly promotes which Preamble objective? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (18/03/2026) Shift 2)

question_hi: अनुच्छेद 39A के अंतर्गत नि:शुल्क विधिक सहायता प्रदान करना अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से उद्देशिका के किस उद्देश्य को बढ़ावा देता है? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (18/03/2026) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: Which amendment made it constitutionally mandatory for municipalities to prepare “District Planning Committees” and “Metropolitan Planning Committees”? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (22/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: 74th Amendment
102nd Amendment
97th Amendment
73rd Amendment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 74th Amendment.

Explanation:
The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 deals with municipalities in India. It gave constitutional status to urban local bodies. This amendment mandated the formation of District Planning Committees (DPCs) and Metropolitan Planning Committees (MPCs) for municipalities. DPCs coordinate planning at the district level, while MPCs plan for metropolitan areas. These committees ensure coordination between rural and urban areas. The 74th Amendment added Part IX-A to the Constitution and includes the Twelfth Schedule, which lists 18 functions of municipalities. Other options: 73rd Amendment relates to Panchayati Raj; 97th Amendment to cooperative societies; 102nd Amendment to the National Commission for Backward Classes.

question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किस संशोधन ने नगरपालिकाओं के लिए "जिला योजना समितियां (District Planning Committees)" और "महानगरीय योजना समितियां (Metropolitan Planning Committees)" गठित करना संवैधानिक रूप से अनिवार्य बना दिया?

(RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (22/03/2026) Shift 1)
options_hi: 74वां संशोधन
102वां संशोधन
97वां संशोधन
73वां संशोधन
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 74वां संशोधन.

Explanation:
1992 का 74वां संविधान संशोधन भारत में नगरपालिकाओं से संबंधित है। इसने शहरी स्थानीय सरकारों को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया। इस अधिनियम ने नगरपालिकाओं के लिए जिला योजना समितियों (DPC) और महानगरीय योजना समितियों (MPC) का गठन अनिवार्य किया। DPC जिला स्तर पर योजनाओं का समन्वय करती है, जबकि MPC महानगरीय क्षेत्रों के लिए योजना बनाती है। ये समितियाँ ग्रामीण और शहरी क्षेत्रों के बीच समन्वय सुनिश्चित करती हैं। 74वां संशोधन संविधान में भाग IX-A जोड़ता है और इसमें 12वीं अनुसूची शामिल है, जिसमें नगरपालिकाओं के 18 कार्य सूचीबद्ध हैं। अन्य विकल्प: 73वां संशोधन पंचायती राज से संबंधित है; 97वां संशोधन सहकारी समितियों से; 102वां संशोधन पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग से।
